Source: Acinetobacter baumannii (A. baumannii) represents a global threat owing to its ability to resist most of the currently available antimicrobial agents.

Yoruba: Acinetobacter baumannii (A. baumannii) ló ṣasojú dídẹ́rùbà gbogbo àgbáyé nípa níní ìkápá láti tako ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ohun to lè pa àwọn ǹǹkan elémìí kékèké tí a kò lè fojú rí tí ó wà lọ́wọ́ lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Igciwane i-Acinetobacter baumannii (A. baumannii) liletha usongo lomhlaba wonke ngenxa yekhono lalo lokumelana neziningi zezilapha magciwane ama-antimicrobial agents atholakalayo njengamanje.
Hausa: Acinetobacter baumannii (A. baumannii) ya zama barazana ga duniya saboda ta iya jurewa mafi yawan sinadaran magungunan antibayotik da ake samu a halin yanzu.
Northern Sotho: Acinetobacter baumannii (A. baumannii) e emetše tšhošetšo ya lefase ka bophara ka lebaka la ge e kgona go palela bontši bja dihlare tša go bolaya dipaktheria tšeo di hwetšagalago mo lebakeng le.

Source: Moreover, emergence of carbapenem resistant A. baumannii (CR-AB) isolates limits the available treatment options.

Source: Enzymatic degradation by variety of ß-lactamases, have been identified as the most common mechanism of carbapenem resistance in A. baumannii.

Source: The present study was performed to assess the prevalence and characterize carbapenemases among 206 CR-AB isolated from various clinical specimens collected from different intensive care units at Kasr Al-Aini Hospital.

Source: Molecular screening of 13 common Ambler class bla carbapenemases genes in addition to insertion sequence (IS-1) upstream OXA-23 were performed by using four sets of multiplex PCR, followed by identification using gene sequencing technology.

Hausa: Binciken ƙwayoyin halitta 13 na sanannen ajin Ambler bla carbapenemasis haɗi da jerin shigarwa (IS-1) OXA-23 na sama an yi su ta hanyar amfani da saiti guda huɗu na PCR, sannan aka bambamce su ta hanyar amfani da fasaha na jerin ƙwayoyin halitta.

Source: Researchers identified genes of a bacteria known as Acinetobacter baumannii, which might allow this microorganism to evade current treatments.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi baazuula endagabutonde z’akawuka akamanyiddwa nga Acinetobacter baumannii, eziyinza okusobozesa akawuka kano okwebalama eddagala eririwo kaakano.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàwárí ẹ̀yọ́ ìran ààrùn bakitérìà tí a mọ̀ sí Acinetobacter baumannii, tí ó jẹ́ kí àwọn ǹǹkan abẹ̀mí kékèké yẹra fún ìtọ́jú tó ń lọ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́.

Source: Specifically, they noticed that a gene called blaOXA-23 was common in bacteria found in vulnerable patients in intensive care units (ICUs) of Egyptian hospitals.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala, baazuula ng’endagabutonde eyitibwa blaOXA-23 yeeyoleka nnyo mu buwuka obusangibwa mu balwadde abalina obwetaavu mu woodi z’abayi (ICUs) mu malwaliro g’e Misiri.
Yoruba: Ní pàtó, wọ́n ṣe àkíyèsí ẹ̀yọ́ ìran kan tí ń ṣe blaOXA-23 tí ó wọ́pọ̀ nínu ààrùn bakitéríà tí a rí lára àwọn aláìsàn tó lè ní ìpalára ní àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn (ICUs) ti ìlú Egypt.
Zulu: Impela, babonile ukuthi ufuzo olubizwa nge-blaOXA-23 ivamile kakhulu kwigciwane elitholakala ezigulini ezibudengwane ezisemagumbini abucayi(ICUs) asezibhedlela zase Gibhithe.
Hausa: Musamman, sun lura cewa ƙwayar halittar da ake kira blaOXA-23 ta zama ruwan dare a cikin ƙwayoyin cuta da aka samu a cikin marasa lafiya masu rauni a cikin sassan kulawa mai zurfi (ICUs) na asibitocin Masar.
Northern Sotho: Gabotse, ba lemogile gore tšini ye e bitšwago blaOXA-23 e tlwaelegile ka go paktheria ye e hweditšwego go balwetši bao ba lego kotsing ka mafelong a go alafela balwetši ba go bakwa le badimo (di-ICU) ka dipetleleng tša Egypt.
Amharic: በተለይም ብላOXA-23 የተባለው ጂን በግብጽ ሆስፒታሎች ከፍተኛ እንክብካቤ ክፍል (አይሲዩዎች) ውስጥ ባሉ ተጋላጭ ታካሚዎች ውስጥ በሚገኙ ባክቴሪያዎች ላይ የተለመደ መሆኑን አስተውለዋል፡፡

Source: In general, patients in ICUs in hospitals are especially vulnerable to bacterial infections.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, abalwadde abali mu woodi z’abayi mu malwaliro babeera n’emikisa mingi okufuna obulwadde obuleetebwa obuwuka.
Yoruba: Lápapọ̀, aláìsàn tó wà ní àwọn ICU ní ilé-ìwòsàn má ń sábà wà nínú ewu ààrùn bakitérìà.
Zulu: Ngokujwayelekile, ikakhulu kazi iziguli ezikuma ICUs ezibhedlela zivuleleke kakhulu ekutheni zihaqwe amagciwane.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, marasa lafiya a cikin ICUs a asibitoci suna da haɗari musamman ga cututtukan ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, balweti bao ba lego ka di-ICU ka dipetleleng ba tloga ba eba kotsing ya go fetelwa ke dipatheria.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ በሆስፒታሎች ያሉ የአይሲዩዎች ታካሚዎች በተለይ ለባክቴሪያ ኢንፌክሽን የተጋለጡ ናቸው፡፡

Source: Unfortunately, many bacteria become resistant to antibiotics, meaning that they evolve ways to escape the deadly effects of these drugs.
Luganda: Ebyembi, obuwuka bungi butuuka ne bugumira eddagala eritta obuwuka, ekitegeeza nti bufuna engeri y’okwebalama ebiva mu ddagala lino eby’omutawaana.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láànú pé, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ bakitérìà ló ń lòdì sí egbòogi gbogbonìṣe, léyìí tó túmọ̀ sí pé wọ́n ń wá ọ̀nà àti sá fún ipa oró àwọn ògùn náà.
Zulu: Okubuhlungu, ukuthi amagciwane amaningi aseyakwazi ukumelana nomuthi wokubulala amagciwane, okuchaza ukuthi aseba nezindlela zokubalekela okungenziwa imithi yokwelapha.
Hausa: Abin takaici, yawancin ƙwayoyin cuta sun zama masu juriya ga maganin rigakafi, ma'ana suna haifar da hanyoyi don guje wa mummunar tasirin waɗannan ƙwayoyi.
Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi, dipatheria tše ntši di thoma go šita dianthipayothiki, go era gore di fetogafetoga gore di palele diabe tša dihlare tše.

Source: In many Egyptian hospitals and in the rest of the world, a bacteria called Acinetobacter baumannii has developed drug resistance and is causing illness.
Luganda: Mu malwaliro mangi e Misiri ne mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala, akawuka akayitibwa Acinetobacter baumannii kagumira eddagala era ne kaba nga kaleetawo obulwadde.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ ilé-ìwòsàn tí àwọn ará ìlú Egypt àti àwọn tó kù lágbàyé, ààrùn baketérìà kan tí ń ṣe Acinetobacter baumannii ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ń lódì sí ògùn tí ó sì ń fa àìléra.
Zulu: Ezibhedlela eziningi zase Gibhithe nase mhlabeni wonke, igciwane elibizwa nge-Acinetobacter baumannii isikhule yakwazi ukumelana nemithi yokwelapha futhi isibanga ukugula.
Hausa: A yawancin asibitocin ƙasar Masar da ma sauran kasashen duniya, wata ƙwayar cuta mai suna Acinetobacter baumannii ta samu juriya na shan magani kuma tana haddasa rashin lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka dipetleleng tše ntši tša Egypt le lefaseng ka bophara, paktheria ye e bitšwago Acinetobacter baumannii e thomile go palela dihlare ebile e baka bolwetši.
Amharic: በብዙ የግብጽ ሆስፒታሎች እና በተቀረው አለም አሰኒቶባክተር ቦውማኒ የተባለ ባክቴሪያ መድሃኒት የመቋቋም አቅምን በማዳበር ለበሽታ መከሰት ምክንያት ሆኗል፡፡

Source: Researchers wanted to find out how many patients in a particular hospital had this bacterial infection, and which resistance genes are the most common in these bacteria.
Luganda: Abanonyereza baayagala okuzuula abalwadde bameka mu ddwaliro erimu abaalina obulwadde bw’akawuka kano, era ndagabutonde ki eziviirako okugumira eddagala ezisinga okweyoleka mu buwuka buno.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ mọ iye aláìsàn ní ilé-ìwòsàn kan tí ó ní ààrùn bakitéríà, àti irú ẹ̀yọ́ ìran atako-ààrùn tó wọ́pọ̀ jù nínu ààrùn bakitéríà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi zingaki iziguli kuleso sibhedlela esezike zaba nokuhaqwa ileligciwane, nanokuthi iluphi ufuzo olulwayo oluvamile ukutholakala kulamagciwane.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun so su gano majinyata nawa ne a wani asibiti da ke da wannan cuta ta, da kuma waɗanne ƙwayoyin halitta masu juriya ne suka fi yawa a cikin waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba gore ke balwetši ba bakae ka sepetleleng se itšego bao ba bilego le phetetšo ye ya paktheria, le gore ke ditšini dife tšeo di palelago dihlare tšeo di tlwaelegilego ka mo go dipaktheria tše.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በአንድ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ ምን ያህል ታካሚዎች በተለይ የዚህ ባክቴሪያ ኢንፌክሽን እንደነበራቸው እና በባክቴሪያዎቹ ውስጥም በጣም የተለመዱት የትኞቹ የመከላከያ ጂኖች እንደሆኑ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: This information can help researchers understand better how the bacteria spreads, and how it develops resistance against antibiotic drugs.
Luganda: Obubaka buno buyinza okuyamba abanoonyereza okutegeera obulungi engeri obuwuka gye busaasaanamu, n’engeri gye butuuka okugumira eddagala eritta obuwuka.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ma jẹ́ kí àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí ní òye kí́kún nípa bí ààrùn bakitérìà ṣe ń tànká, àti bí ó ṣé ń gbógun ti ògùn gbogbonìṣe.
Zulu: Lolulwazi lungasiza abacwaningi ukuthi bazi kancono ukuthi igciwane lisabalala kanjani, nanokuthi likhula kanjani lize likwazi ukulwisana nemithi yokubulala wona lamagciwane.
Hausa: Wannan bayanin zai iya taimaka wa masu bincike su fahimci mafi kyawun yadda ƙwayoyin cuta ke yaɗuwa, da kuma yadda suke haɓaka juriya ga magungunan ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Tshedimošo ye e ka thuša banyakišiši go kwešiša bokaone ka fao paktheria e phatlalalago ka gona, le ka fao e thomago go palela dihlare tša dianthipayothiki.
Amharic: ይህ መረጃ ለተመራማሪዎቹ ባክቴሪያው እንዴት እንደሚሰራጭ እና የአንቲባዮቲክ መድሃኒቶች ተጋትሮን እንዴት እንደሚያዳብር በተሻለ መንገድ ለመረዳት ያስችላቸዋል፡፡

Source: They studied samples from 206 Egyptian ICU patients who had this bacterial infection.
Luganda: Beekaliriza sampolo okuva mu balwadde 206 mu woodi y’abayi e Misiri abaalina obulwadde obuleetebwa akawuka kano.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí lára àwọn ọmọ ìlú Egypt tí wọ́n tó bí i 206 tọ́ jẹ́ aláìsàn ICU tí wọ́n ní ààrùn bakitéríà.
